<!-- pr-reviewer: c0a58d36be1e4bf3d868529e0cb6c2fc559dc781 -->
Code review clean. The PR conflicts with main and cannot merge yet.

The Zigzag rows and closing passes have independent coverage tests. Parameter validation, undo, project storage, and MCP use the existing command path. Adaptive remains refused. The path states its previous-tool trust assumption.

Local verification:

The trial merge with upstream/main at `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425` failed in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs`. I aborted the merge. The results below apply to the PR head, not a combined tree. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Motion unit tests | 366 passed; 5 ignored |
| Motion machining2d | 66 passed |
| Motion pocket_refusal | 3 passed |
| Motion rest2d | 10 passed |
| Motion rest_zigzag | 2 passed |
| Motion predrilled_entry | 6 passed |
| App unit tests, golden_cl, predrilled_entry | Passed |
| App project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| App rest_pocket | 6 passed |
| App tool_gate | 9 passed |
| UI unit tests, from crates/ui | 813 passed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy: motion, app, UI; all targets; -D warnings | Passed |

The quick-gate dry run selected most app suites. This review ran the targeted suites above, not the full workspace gate.

Safety review: I ran two mutations locally.

- Remove the closing rings: the coverage test failed with 287 missed points instead of 0. Restore the source: both Zigzag tests passed.
- Replace the capped inset with a fixed 0.01 mm inset: the tiny-pocket test failed with `the closing ring alone leaves the pocket center uncut`. Restore the source: both Zigzag tests passed.

The source was restored byte for byte. The worktree had no tracked changes after verification.

I read all 128 lines of the new `pocket_rest_corners.cl` golden. It has four corner passes at three heights. Lateral rapids remain at or above the stock top. No existing golden changes in the PR diff.

Requested before merge: resolve the conflict in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs` when this stack reaches its merge turn. Merge parent #1817 first, as the PR body states. Verify the combined tree after the refresh.

Notes: `mill2d_page.rs` only preserves the rest field. The other UI edits update test fixtures. No visible control changes, so before/after UI images do not apply. The dialog is tracked separately in #1815. The body includes `Process change: yes`. No dependency, build script, or workflow changes require a maintainer-only build decision.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
